dom.introText:
4
Tide jar

Every fourth pour on the board, the tide turns: the sand in the tide jar rises by one layer, and its bottom layer comes up to the top. The number on its wave counts the pours left. A sealed tide jar stays still.
labels241: Jar 7: saffron, mint, coral, denim (tide jar, turns in 4 pours)
craftedLabels: Jar 1: terracotta; saffron; wet sage, dries in 3 pours (tide jar, turns after the next pour)
Jar 2: lagoon, lagoon, lagoon, lagoon (tide jar, still, sealed)
afterLabels: Jar 1: saffron; wet sage, dries in 2 pours; terracotta (tide jar, turns in 4 pours)
Jar 2: lagoon, lagoon, lagoon, lagoon (tide jar, still, sealed)
announce: Poured 1 sage into jar 4. The tide turned (jar 1).
